Messages.Author: Michael Beer
Messages.Body:
Beast cannot take an equip action.

The text on Zip Gun states:

"Can only be BROUGHT into play ... This card is KEPT as normal equipment
and not discarded after combat."

Question: Can Beast get a Zip Gun?
